very_low_decisions.reason: Unidentified bony-fish composition is unknown across named stocks and mixed residuals; whole-group quantities include some ineligible members in shared pools.
Brill was pooled with turbot in 2007, whereas the 2015 group is renamed Turbot and revised. Continued brill membership is not established.
Broad Scombridae spans mackerel and source-accounted tunas in a mixed residual; the actual mixture and taxon-specific pool quantities are unknown.
Broad elasmobranch composition is unknown across named and residual sharks/rays and juvenile stages; chimaeras are excluded.
Broad dogfish reporting scope is uncertain between spurdog, small dogfish and juveniles.
Broad squaliform composition spans several shark analogues and juvenile stages; no measured mixture is available.
Broad cod-family reporting may use historical family boundaries; composition across named stocks, residuals and stages is unknown.
Broad ray/skate labels have unknown composition across named, residual and juvenile ray pools.
Broad crab labels span large commercial crabs and small mobile epifauna; the actual mixture is unknown.
Scophthalmid reporting scope and species mixture are unobserved across turbot, megrim and small-flatfish representatives.
Tuna, bonito and billfish labels use Mackerel as an explicitly weak pelagic-predator analogue; the source lacks their size and migratory compartments.
Historical Perciformes reporting may cross several modern lineages and model guilds; pool amounts approximate unknown composition.
Marine-crustacean composition is unknown across pelagic, commercial benthic, small sediment/interface and attached forms; mixed-pool catches are an approximation.
Freshwater or diadromous taxa use the residual containing seatrout as an analogue; freshwater production, migration and taxon-specific feeding are not represented.
Sea-snail composition is unknown across epifaunal and infaunal source pools; model catches approximate the mixture.
Gadiform catch spans stocks and mixed residual pools; source-pool quantities include non-gadiform members and approximate the unknown mixture.
Miscellaneous invertebrate composition is unidentified across taxonomic and habitat pools; modeled proportions are a broad approximation.
Broad echinoderm labels span surface and sediment-dwelling members with unobserved composition.
Unrepresented predatory pelagic fishes use Mackerel as an analogue; taxonomy, depth or body form differs from the source stock.
Broad bivalve composition is unknown across mobile, infaunal and attached pools; source catch zeros do not prove absent regional catch.
Deep-water gadiform relatives are approximated by OtherLargeGadoids; the source does not establish their membership or deep-water trophic regime.
Freshwater cyprinids use the source freshwater-bream/SmallDemersalFish analogue; species composition, freshwater production and feeding differ.
Broad crustacean composition is unknown across commercial decapods and smaller benthic crustaceans.
Historical scorpaeniform reporting spans gurnards and two mixed residuals; exact taxa and composition are unknown.
Unidentified pelagic bony-fish composition spans named forage/predator stocks and mixed residuals; full residual quantities are only a proxy for their eligible pelagic members.
Broad cartilaginous-fish composition is unknown; the chimaera contribution uses a mixed residual whose quantities also contain bony fish.
Scabbardfish/cutlassfish lack a named source stock and use a larger benthopelagic predator analogue.
Unlisted deep-water fishes use the larger residual via source redfish/grenadier analogues; exact habitat and trophic composition are unverified.
Non-rajid rays are approximated by the rajid residual/juvenile pools; source taxonomy and juvenile definition do not directly contain them.
Angelshark is a flattened benthic ambush predator absent from the source. Demersal small-shark members are only a functional analogue.
Broad mollusc composition is unknown across cephalopod and benthic habitat pools, some of which contain non-molluscs.
Malacostracan reporting can include krill and several benthic decapod pools; the actual composition is unknown.
Spiny lobsters are approximated by the Homarus-containing LargeCrabs pool, with different family and shelter/burrowing ecology.
Anomuran size and species composition are unknown between large decapods and smaller mobile epifauna.
Unlisted deep-water dogfish use the SmallSharks/juvenile union via the source velvet-belly analogue; depth and species composition are unrepresented.
Basking shark follows the predecessor whale-pool filter-feeding analogue, with an extreme fish–mammal physiological mismatch.
Unlisted large sharks are represented by the tope/porbeagle/thresher functional analogue despite depth or biogeographic mismatch.
Bighead carp uses a marine planktivore analogue despite freshwater habitat and different plankton composition.
Unidentified bony groundfish composition is unknown across demersal stocks, stages and mixed residuals.
Unidentified diadromous taxa span predatory and forage-fish analogues; freshwater production and the mixture are not observed.
Ocean sunfish lacks a matching trophic compartment; the pelagic-fish Mackerel analogue differs strongly in body form and feeding.
Broad salmonid composition spans salmon/trout and whitefish representations; freshwater production and the source whitefish conflict remain unresolved biologically.
